Browser Callback Self-Contained Demo.commands:
---
name: Browser Callback Self-Contained Demo
description: "Exercises browser_callback_capture locally in both query and fragment modes using fake callback values and loopback URLs. Requires: one selected/current host row, a single-host run, a desktop browser on the same machine, and local port 38086 to be available; no SSH session or external identity provider is used. Expected: pass."
version: 1
debug: true
noBanner: true
vars:
  qa_query_path: "/browser_callback_query_test"
  qa_fragment_path: "/browser_callback_fragment_test"
  qa_state: "browser-callback-state"
  qa_query_code: "qa-code-123"
  qa_fragment_token: "qa-token-456"
  qa_fragment_type: "Bearer"
steps:
  - print:
      message: "This preset opens the browser twice against localhost: first for query capture, then for fragment capture."
  - browser_callback_capture:
      start_url: "http://127.0.0.1:38086${qa_query_path}?code=${qa_query_code}&state=${qa_state}"
      callback_path: "${qa_query_path}"
      local_port: 38086
      capture_mode: query
      into: query_capture
      required_fields:
        - code
        - state
      timeout: 30
      quiet: false
  - assert:
      condition: "query_capture_code == qa_query_code and query_capture_state == qa_state and query_capture_keys contains 'code' and query_capture_keys contains 'state'"
      message: "Expected query-mode callback capture to persist code and state values"
  - print:
      message: "Query capture succeeded with keys: ${query_capture_keys}"
  - browser_callback_capture:
      start_url: "http://127.0.0.1:38086${qa_fragment_path}#access_token=${qa_fragment_token}&token_type=${qa_fragment_type}&state=${qa_state}"
      callback_path: "${qa_fragment_path}"
      local_port: 38086
      capture_mode: fragment
      into: fragment_capture
      required_fields:
        - access_token
        - token_type
        - state
      timeout: 30
      quiet: false
  - assert:
      condition: "fragment_capture_access_token == qa_fragment_token and fragment_capture_token_type == qa_fragment_type and fragment_capture_state == qa_state and fragment_capture_keys contains 'access_token' and fragment_capture_keys contains 'token_type' and fragment_capture_keys contains 'state'"
      message: "Expected fragment-mode callback capture to bridge hash values back into the listener"
  - print:
      message: "Fragment capture succeeded with keys: ${fragment_capture_keys}"
  - exit: success PASS - Browser Callback Self-Contained Demo
